name: @phneakngar/app
description: Run ភ្នាក់ងារ locally — one command, no clone needed

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external commander --external wrangler && node scripts/bundle-cli.mjs
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && node -e "const{existsSync}=require('fs');if(!existsSync('bundled/web'))throw new Error('bundled/ missing — run pnpm bundle first')"
